messages:
pagerbot: PAGER: INC-2026-045 -> high rate of 401/403 from proxy-prod-usw2, sudden spike starting ~10m ago. affected service: indexer-api. alert: https://alerts.internal/INC-2026-045 :rotating_light:
Tom (oncall-sre): on it, acknowledging. pulling request trace and proxy logs now. any customer reports?
Rachel (customer-success): small cluster of customers in orgs flagged by Sentry saying session flapping, one reported repeated auth failures. no public-facing outage yet.
Maya (security): quick look — traffic shows repeated token reuse from ~54.85.12.0/24 hitting indexer. headers include long user-agent + possible forwarded x-auth header. could be leaked debug logs or a forwarder.
Owen (eng): fyi we did a logging agent update 30m before spike, rolled to 10% initially. i'm going to check log-forwarder routing rules — might have accidentally forwarded request headers to the analytics bucket.
Tom (oncall-sre): if headers leaked to analytics S3 we need to quarantine that bucket immediately and rotate any affected credentials. can infra apply a quarantine ACL and block public access?
infra-bot: applied temporary block to s3://redwood-analytics-indexer-raw. PutObject disabled, GetObject restricted to internal. policy id: q-1749.
Maya (security): good. next: search recent objects for patterns like "Authorization: Bearer" or "x-session-token" and mark objects for forensic hold. avoid mass deletions — legal needs preservation.
Amy (legal): preserve preserved objects in separate hold bucket. legal review will advise PII handling; do not notify customers until we have scope.
Owen (eng): reproducing quick grep locally. suggestion: flip log-forwarder into quarantine mode (route to isolation bucket) and disable header capture.
Owen (eng): commands: ```
# quarantine forwarder
kubectl set env deployment/log-forwarder QUARANTINE_MODE=true -n infra
# block header capture
kubectl set env deployment/proxy REDACT_HEADERS=true -n proxy
```
Tom (oncall-sre): doing rotation plan for service accounts that have access to analytics bucket and indexer write keys. we'll rotate service-account-indexer and analytics-forwarder keys, TTL to 5m during rotation. who can own rotating keys for indexer?
Owen (eng): i can take indexer keys. will coordinate with infra for KMS and CI secrets.
Maya (security): i'll coordinate auth telemetry and look for token reuse across other regions. also recommend adding ephemeral binding for the new keys and monitoring 401/403 rate with a tighter alert for 5xx burst.
Rachel (customer-success): if we confirm leaked headers include customer-identifiers we'll need customer comms. prepping a template but will hold until legal clears.
Tom (oncall-sre): timeline: 0-15m quarantine + hold, 15-45m rotate keys and reissue, 45-90m validate and lift quarantine if clean. opening incident ticket INC-2026-045 and Postmortem board.
Maya (security): two questions: any suspected exfil beyond s3? check fluentd outputs to external endpoints and ELK exporters. Owen can you grep fluentd config?
Owen (eng): checking now — fluentd endpoints show only internal endpoints, but there is a misconfigured secondary output to analytics ingestion (disabled flag flipped to false). disabling it now.
Owen (eng): ```
# disable secondary output
kubectl patch cm fluentd-config -n logging --type merge -p '{"data": {"secondary_output": "disabled"}}'
```
infra-bot: rotation started for service-account-indexer: request 1729-rot-1. KMS request queued.
Tom (oncall-sre): after keys rotated, deploy a canary to proxy to ensure no credential regressions. will monitor 401 rate.
Maya (security): i'll run a quick search for shop-sessions or customer ids in recent uploads and flag objects with matches. share list to legal privately.
Amy (legal): confirmed — we have notification chain ready. once we know the scope we'll coordinate CS and compliance comms. preserve chain-of-custody.
Rachel (customer-success): standing by to draft sensitive-customer outreach if needed. please ping me with list of impacted orgs.
Tom (oncall-sre): update: rotated analytics-forwarder creds and indexer service-account keys at +28m. proxy redaction env set. watching auth metrics.
infra-bot: KMS rotation complete. new keys issued, old keys revoked.
Owen (eng): deployed patched log-forwarder config to 100% with header redact and secondary_output disabled.
Maya (security): initial scan shows 12 objects with header snippets, all within the quarantine hold bucket. no obvious customer PII found in headers but continuing deeper scan.
Tom (oncall-sre): auth spike trending down, 401 rate back to baseline at +62m. continuing monitoring for 2h.
Maya (security): starting incident-level audit and will summarize indicators and IOCs for SOC.
Amy (legal): hold for now on customer comms. will advise after SOC summary.
Rachel (customer-success): copied. will wait for list before outreach.
Tom (oncall-sre): closing live bridge for now — incident status -> mitigated. follow-ups: postmortem, rotate any other long-lived creds, improve deploy gating for logging agent. assigning owners in INC-2026-045. :white_check_mark:
pagerbot: INC-2026-045 status changed to MITIGATED by Tom (oncall-sre) at +90m
